$schema: grammar-app tag taxonomy — reference for filtering/sorting grammar points by their `tags` array
notes: Each grammar point can carry 1-4 tags. Tags are drawn from this fixed vocabulary so the UI can offer a stable filter list instead of free text. Grouped into facets below purely for UI organization (e.g. separate filter sections) — the tags themselves live in one flat `tags` array on each grammar point, facet membership is not stored per-item.

function.label: Function / Meaning
function.description: What the grammar point communicatively does. The primary facet — most points get 1-2 of these.

cause-reason.label: Reason / Cause
cause-reason.description: Marks the reason/cause behind a following statement or result.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.description: Expresses a goal or intention behind an action (in order to / for the sake of).

result-consequence.label: Result / Consequence
result-consequence.description: Marks a resulting state or consequence.

conditional.label: Conditional
conditional.description: Hypothetical or conditional clauses (if/when X, then Y).

concession-contrast.label: Concession / Contrast
concession-contrast.description: Despite/although X, Y — a contrastive or concessive relationship.

comparison.label: Comparison
comparison.description: Comparing two things by degree, similarity, or preference.

degree-extent.label: Degree / Extent
degree-extent.description: Expresses degree, extent, or a scale (how much / to what extent).

similarity-appearance.label: Similarity / Appearance
similarity-appearance.description: Describes how something looks/resembles/seems (visual or general resemblance).

hearsay.label: Hearsay
hearsay.description: Reporting information obtained from another source (I heard that...).

conjecture-inference.label: Conjecture / Inference
conjecture-inference.description: The speaker's own guess/inference/supposition, based on reasoning or observation.

certainty-expectation.label: Certainty / Expectation
certainty-expectation.description: Strong conviction that something is/should be the case (はず, に違いない).

possibility.label: Possibility
possibility.description: Expresses that something may or may not be the case.

obligation-necessity.label: Obligation / Necessity
obligation-necessity.description: Must/have to do something; no choice but to.

advice-suggestion.label: Advice / Suggestion
advice-suggestion.description: Giving or requesting advice/suggestions on the best course of action.

request.label: Request
request.description: Asking someone (politely or directly) to do something.

passive.label: Passive
passive.description: Passive voice — an action done to the subject.

causative.label: Causative
causative.description: Making or letting someone do something.

causative-passive.label: Causative-Passive
causative-passive.description: Being made/forced to do something by someone else.

potential.label: Potential
potential.description: Ability or possibility of doing something.

volitional-intention.label: Volition / Intention
volitional-intention.description: The speaker's will, plan, or intention to do something.

decision-outcome.label: Decision / Outcome
decision-outcome.description: A decision reached, or an outcome that has been decided/settled.

experience.label: Experience
experience.description: Past experience of having done something.

change-of-state.label: Change of State
change-of-state.description: A shift from one state/condition to another over time.

habit-effort.label: Habit / Effort
habit-effort.description: Ongoing habits, customary actions, or deliberate effort to form one.

giving-receiving.label: Giving / Receiving
giving-receiving.description: Giving/receiving verbs (あげる・くれる・もらう family and their honorific forms).

quotation.label: Quotation
quotation.description: Quoting or reporting what was said, named, or written.

nominalizer.label: Nominalizer
nominalizer.description: Turns a clause/verb into a noun phrase (の／こと).

listing-examples.label: Listing Examples
listing-examples.description: Listing representative examples out of a larger, unstated set.

time-relative.label: Relative Time
time-relative.description: Marks a point or span in time relative to an action or event.

state-continuation.label: State Continuation
state-continuation.description: A state that persists or continues, often as the result of a prior action.

attempt.label: Attempt
attempt.description: Trying an action to see what happens.

preparation.label: Preparation
preparation.description: Doing something in advance / getting something ready.

completion.label: Completion
completion.description: An action finished fully, or finishing an action.

excessive-degree.label: Excessive Degree
excessive-degree.description: Doing/being something to an excessive degree.

ease-difficulty.label: Ease / Difficulty
ease-difficulty.description: How easy or difficult it is to do/handle something.

emphasis-limitation.label: Emphasis / Limitation
emphasis-limitation.description: Emphasizing, restricting, or limiting scope (only, even, at least).

viewpoint-standpoint.label: Viewpoint / Standpoint
viewpoint-standpoint.description: Framing a statement from a particular standpoint, role, or perspective.

explanation.label: Explanation
explanation.description: Framing a statement as an explanation that follows from context (んです family).

spontaneous-perception.label: Spontaneous Perception
spontaneous-perception.description: A sensory perception or spontaneous occurrence, not a deliberate action.

creation-completion.label: Creation / Completion
creation-completion.description: Something coming into being, being made, or being completed.

simultaneous-action.label: Simultaneous Action
simultaneous-action.description: Two actions/states happening at the same time.

manner-accordance.label: Manner / Accordance
manner-accordance.description: Doing something exactly in accordance with/as instructed.

alternative-choice.label: Alternative / Choice
alternative-choice.description: Choosing one course of action over another / instead of.

emotion-expression.label: Emotion Expression
emotion-expression.description: Describing a third person's apparent emotional state.

negative-manner.label: Negative Manner
negative-manner.description: Doing one thing without doing another (ずに／ないで family).

partial-negation.label: Partial Negation
partial-negation.description: Softening a negation — doesn't necessarily mean / isn't quite the case that.

definition-meaning.label: Definition / Meaning
definition-meaning.description: Defining or classifying what something means or is.

direction-movement.label: Direction / Movement
direction-movement.description: Physical or metaphorical direction of movement.

acknowledgment.label: Acknowledgment
acknowledgment.description: A short response registering that the speaker has received/understood new information (そうですか family).

confirmation-seeking.label: Confirmation Seeking
confirmation-seeking.description: Sentence-final ね/よね, inviting the listener's agreement or confirming shared understanding.

emphasis-assertion.label: Emphasis / Assertion
emphasis-assertion.description: Sentence-final よ, asserting information the listener doesn't know or stating the speaker's judgment firmly.

register.label: Register / Formality
register.description: Where the grammar point sits on the casual-to-formal spectrum, or which keigo tier it belongs to. Useful for filtering 'show me only stiff/written N3 patterns' or 'show me keigo'.

formal-written.label: Formal / Written
formal-written.description: Stiff, formal register typical of writing, news, speeches, or business Japanese.

keigo-respectful.label: Keigo: Respectful
keigo-respectful.description: 尊敬語 — elevating the listener/referent's actions.

keigo-humble.label: Keigo: Humble
keigo-humble.description: 謙譲語 — lowering the speaker's own actions.

keigo-polite.label: Keigo: Polite
keigo-polite.description: 丁寧語 — general politeness, independent of relative status.

structure.label: Structure Type
structure.description: What kind of grammatical unit this is, independent of meaning — useful for filters like 'just show me particles' or 'hide meta/formation entries'.

meta-conjugation.label: Conjugation Pattern
meta-conjugation.description: Teaches how to form/conjugate a verb group (potential, passive, causative, etc.) rather than a new meaning.

particle-usage.label: Particle Usage
particle-usage.description: A specific case-particle nuance or usage point not covered by a more specific function tag.

topic-focus-particle.label: Topic / Focus Particle
topic-focus-particle.description: Particle usage for marking topic/focus (は, が, も, etc.).

nominalizer.label: Nominalizer
nominalizer.description: Turns a clause/verb into a noun phrase (の／こと).

connective.label: Connective
connective.description: A sentence-initial conjunction linking to the previous sentence.

question-embedding.label: Question Embedding
question-embedding.description: Embedding a question inside a larger sentence.

usage_guidance.ambiguous_points: Some points genuinely span multiple functions (e.g. はず carries both certainty-expectation and, loosely, conjecture-inference — it was tagged with just certainty-expectation to keep the certainty scale distinct and filterable from the looser conjecture family: でしょう/かもしれない/ようです/らしい). When a point is ambiguous, prefer the tag that groups it with the points it is most often confused with or drilled against, since that's the filtering use case that matters most for review.
usage_guidance.adding_new_tags: Only add a new tag to this taxonomy if 2+ existing tags genuinely don't fit — reusing tags across points is what makes filtering/grouping useful. Keep tag names in this kebab-case, function-first style.
usage_guidance.max_tags_per_point: Aim for 1-3 tags per grammar point (rarely 4). More than that stops being a useful filter signal.
